name: SGD (Street View Synthesis with Gaussian Splatting and Diffusion Prior)
definition: A novel view synthesis method for street scenes that enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting by fine-tuning a Stable Diffusion model on driving data and using it to regularize 3DGS training at unseen viewpoints, addressing the sparse-view reconstruction problem.
summary: SGD enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting for street scenes by fine-tuning Stable Diffusion on driving data to regularize training, addressing sparse-view reconstruction without relying on object-centric datasets.
